spanish: En el día aquel se comerá; no dejarán desde él hasta mañana; yo Jehová.

findings.issue: The min-suffix is 1st common plural (from us); «él» is 3rd masculine singular.
«hasta mañana» is the set phrase until tomorrow; the token is the noun morning.

notes: 2mp hiphil as dejarán is licensed ustedes address; yo Jehová keeps the verbless clause.
